metadata.description: Org-wide engineering standards for GitHub Copilot (CLI and VS Code). Lists steer, which installs the same always-on engineering operating manual that the Claude Code marketplace ships — sourced from one set of rules so all surfaces stay in sync.

plugins.name: steer
plugins.description: An always-on engineering operating manual — stack defaults, monorepo layout, spec workflow, living documentation, issue-tracker integration, testing rules, Definition of Done, drift gates, secrets handling, and compliance-aligned delivery. On Copilot (CLI and VS Code) the plugin's SessionStart hook injects the live rules into every session, so a plugin update is the whole upgrade path; the skills install as a .agents/skills/ tree in the open Agent Skills format -- the same tree Cursor, Gemini CLI and Codex read -- and .github/copilot-instructions.md carries the same rules as the fallback for the Copilot cloud agent and code review, which load no plugins. Run /steer:init from Claude Code to install those files, and /steer:sync after a plugin update to refresh them.
